info.name: Music Player API
info.description:
Postman collection for the GIG Music Player backend.

Base URL: https://musicapp-production-bcd8.up.railway.app/api

HOW TO USE:
1) Run 'Auth > Register' once to create a user (or skip if you already have one).
2) Run 'Auth > Login' -> the access_token & refresh_token get saved automatically.
3) Everything else uses {{access_token}} automatically (collection-level Bearer auth).
4) Run 'Tracks > List Tracks' -> the first track id is saved into {{track_id}}.
5) Run 'Playlists > List Playlists' or 'Create Playlist' -> {{playlist_id}} gets saved.

NOTE: Field names for register/login (username vs email) and playlist (name vs title) are best-guesses. Open /docs on the deployed URL and adjust the request bodies if the API expects different keys.

request.description: Create a new user. Adjust the body keys to match /docs if needed.

response.name: Register

request.description: Log in and receive tokens. If the API uses email instead of username, change the body accordingly (check /docs).
Exchange the refresh token for a new access token.
Get the currently authenticated user's profile.

exec: const items = Array.isArray(res) ? res : (res.results || res.tracks || res.data || []);
